law_text: The City Traffic Engineer shall determine upon what streets angle parking shall be permitted, and shall provide signage or other markings to indicate where such parking is permitted. Where angle parking is permitted, no person shall stand or park a vehicle unless the front of the vehicle is pointed toward the direction of lawful traffic movement.
